summary: Enterprise Products Partners L.P. filed a Form 8-K to disclose entry into a new $1.0 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement for its operating subsidiary, EPO, adding to $4.2 billion existing capacity. The facility matures March 26, 2027, with variable-rate borrowings, quarterly facility fees, and guaranty by the Partnership. Proceeds support working capital, capex, and acquisitions. This is a routine credit facility arrangement, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions apply. Watch for covenant compliance but no special-situation angle.
